payload.title: Document intent from first prose paragraph; numeric closers are not punch lines
payload.description: Found scanning 102 published Anth.us pieces with the Anthus profile. (1) document_intent took the first sentence of any paragraph, so for MDX it was the import line in 84 of 102 scans; it now takes the first prose paragraph. (2) Punch-line cadence flagged short closing sentences that state a number ('A coin flip gets 0.5.'); a numeric statement is a measurement, not a riddle, and is now exempt. Specs: features/editorial-document-intent.feature and a new scenario in editorial-punchline-cadence.feature. Site-board cross-reference: kanbus-9e6b11 in AnthusAI/Anth.us.
